ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure; on the left is a six-membered carbon ring containing a carbonyl group, and on the right side of the ring it is connected to an enol-like fragment bearing OH; the upper right is connected to a fragment containing nitrogen and a sulfonyl group, and N=N, N-N, N-S, two S=O, and S-Me can be seen. There are also curved arrows and positive and negative charge labels in the figure, but these are not used as bond counts; hydrogen-related bonds such as O-H and C-H in Me are also excluded. Reasoning: Count non-hydrogen bonds according to the specified method. The left cyclic fragment has 6 C-C ring bonds, plus 1 carbonyl C=O, 1 C=C connected to the OH-bearing carbon, and 1 C-O bond, for a total of 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9. The upper-right diazo-sulfonyl fragment has N=N, N-N, N-S, two S=O, and S-Me, for a total of 6 non-hydrogen bonds. The total number is 9 + 6 = 15.

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows and charge signs. Count non-H bonds by visual groups: left cyclic fragment has 6 C-C ring bonds plus 1 carbonyl C=O bond plus 1 C=C bond to the OH-bearing carbon plus 1 C-O bond, giving 9. Upper/right diazo-sulfonyl fragment has N=N, N-N, N-S, two S=O bonds, and S-Me, giving 6. Add 9 + 6 = 15.

推理：按指定方法数非氢键。左侧环状片段有 6 个 C-C 环键，加上 1 个羰基 C=O、1 个连接到 OH-bearing carbon 的 C=C、1 个 C-O 键，共 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9。右上 diazo-sulfonyl 片段有 N=N、N-N、N-S、两个 S=O、S-Me，共 6 个非氢键。总数为 9 + 6 = 15。
